headline: EPS grows year-over-year, roughly flat sequentially
summary_short: Mitsubishi Electric reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥53.66, up 22.3% y/y and 0.4% q/q.
summary_long: EPS of ¥53.66 rose 22.3% year-over-year from ¥43.89, and was roughly flat sequentially (+0.4%) versus ¥53.46 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
